additional_info.subject: RE: ID0382108-DC/Si-D/DK-[MP / R3 170001655] Ocpp router toogling between online/offline CRM:00921001146
additional_info.body:
Hello
Martin Koch Pedersen,
Hope you are doing well.
Regarding the issue, we have analyzed the logs and reviewed the router configuration remotely. It appears that the problem lies with the network, as all other parameters are correct.
We recommend ensuring strong network signal strength near the charger.
The RSRP in the above image is higher, indicating that reliable data speeds may be attainable, but marginal data quality with dropouts is possible (a range of -95 to -105 indicates acceptable signal strength, but low speeds and disconnects may occur). As the RSRP approaches -100, performance will drop drastically.
Additionally, the RSRQ is also higher, which indicates a range of -9 to -11. This level suggests interference that can affect the connection.
Regards,
Beerpal Singh
eMobility Support
